lines.text: Field-Ready Mango Health Diagnostic. MangoLeaf AI is a Progressive Web Application that helps Mango Farmers automate the classification of Mango Leaf and Mango Green Fruit conditions, even offline. It requires no login or registration, works offline, runs on-device AI diagnosis, provides English and Bisaya treatment guidance, and includes Scan History.
Support 7 classes. Leaf Diseases include Anthracnose, Sooty Mold, and Bacterial Canker. Fruit Diseases include Mango Scab and Bacterial Black Spot. Healthy results are Healthy Leaf and Healthy Fruit.
MangoLeaf AI Offline-First Tech Stack. Next.js, React, Bun, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. TensorFlow.js, Dexie, IndexedDB, Supabase, and Serwist. Model: MobileNet V3 Large.
Simple Walkthrough. We will show one straightforward path: scan, take a photo, view the diagnosed result, open Scan History, then view the scan detail modal.
MangoLeaf AI checks a Mango Leaf or Mango Green Fruit right on your phone, even when you are offline.
Read the Photo Tips, then use Take Photo for this simple demo. Keep one whole Mango Leaf or Mango Green Fruit in even light.
Center the subject in the Green Box Guidance. Hold steady and use good light so the camera can capture a clear Mango Green Fruit view.
Review your photo. Make sure one whole Mango Leaf or Mango Green Fruit is visible. After that, tap Run AI Diagnosis to start the on-device check.
Please wait a moment while the on-device model checks your photo. After that, review the result.
See the predicted condition, Confidence Score, and treatment guidance in English.
Switch language with One tap so Mango Farmers can understand immediate treatment steps.
Your Scan History keeps earlier results close at hand for a quick review.
Select a saved scan to view its image, diagnosis, and treatment details together.
English and Bisaya treatment guidance are available from the scan details.
MangoLeaf AI brings offline diagnosis, Scan History, and Bisaya guidance together.
